value_policy.rationale: The unchanged integrated upstream heuristic in swap_vma_readahead is the control. Require at least 5% useful gain beyond calibrated noise with passing guards.

selected_idea.bottleneck: Spatial proximity readahead in swap_vma_ra_win expands window prematurely on random access, causing high tail latency.
selected_idea.mechanism: Enforce strict stride gating requiring 2+ contiguous hits before expanding win > 1, and immediately collapse win = 1 on non-contiguous access.
selected_idea.expected_benefit: Eliminate speculative swap readahead I/O on random access, protecting random tail latency while retaining sequential readahead speedups.
selected_idea.simpler_alternative: Disable VMA readahead completely or retain existing spatial proximity heuristic.
selected_idea.falsifier: Reject if sequential throughput degrades significantly, or if random p99 tail latency fails the calibrated noise guard.
required_evidence: Exact-tree independent source review including caller contracts
Fresh probe calibration under Protocol Revision 7
selected_idea.no_upstream_reason: The relevant upstream implementation is already in the frozen baseline.
selected_idea.selection_reason: Directly addresses the root cause of random p99 latency regressions in prior physical readahead experiments.
